ArtifactMetadata.Summary: Comprehensive walkthrough of The Atelier redesign, admin privilege delegation, and password security engine repair

CodeContent:
# Walkthrough: "The Atelier" Visual Redesign & Security Engine Overhaul

## 1. Summary of Changes

### A. Admin Privilege Delegation Engine ("WHY ADMIN PRIVILEGES CANT BE GRANTED")
- **Root Cause Eliminated**: Resolved the runtime `ReferenceError` and missing handler definition for promoting administrators.
- **Bi-Directional Admin Management**:
  - Wired `grantAdminPrivileges` and `revokeAdminPrivileges` from [src/lib/security/passwords.ts](file:///c:/Users/alwis/Documents/antigravity/dazzling-bardeen/src/lib/security/passwords.ts) into [src/app/admin/page.tsx](file:///c:/Users/alwis/Documents/antigravity/dazzling-bardeen/src/app/admin/page.tsx).
  - In the **Members Directory** table, added an inline **"Make Admin"** button for students and a **"Revoke Admin"** button for existing delegated admins.
  - In the **Admin Powers** tab, enhanced the **Authorized Administrators** roster with an active **"Revoke"** action for all delegated admin accounts.
  - Ensured immediate optimistic UI role upgrades and persistent storage in `localDb` and `localStorage`, alongside background synchronization with the remote backend.

### B. Cryptographic Password Authentication & Security Engine
- **Logical Security Restored**:
  - Eliminated the previous disconnected password generator that only copied strings to the clipboard without persisting them.
  - In `EditMemberModal`, added a real **Account Password & Access Credential** management field with high-entropy generator and direct value editing.
  - When saving member edits, `setMemberPassword` computes a **salted SHA-256 hash** (`passwordHash` and `passwordSalt`) and securely stores it in the member profile.
  - Integrated `signInWithPassword` in [src/lib/auth.ts](file:///c:/Users/alwis/Documents/antigravity/dazzling-bardeen/src/lib/auth.ts) and [src/context/AuthContext.tsx](file:///c:/Users/alwis/Documents/antigravity/dazzling-bardeen/src/context/AuthContext.tsx) to verify credentials against stored salted hashes for both email and Study ID logins.

### C. "The Atelier" Visual Design Direction
- **Contemporary Creative Institution Aesthetic**:
  - Created high-resolution Atelier monograms in `public/favicon.svg` and `public/favicon.ico`.
  - Configured Google Fonts `Newsreader` (optical sizes 6–72) and `Playfair Display` alongside `Plus Jakarta Sans` and `JetBrains Mono`.
  - Defined CSS custom properties in [src/app/globals.css](file:///c:/Users/alwis/Documents/antigravity/dazzling-bardeen/src/app/globals.css) for warm ivory paper (`#FBF9F5`), soft oatmeal (`#F5F1E9`), deep forest ink (`#132219`), stone hairline borders (`#E5DDD0`), and restrained terracotta clay-red (`#C85A32`).
  - Restyled [src/components/lms/LmsHeader.tsx](file:///c:/Users/alwis/Documents/antigravity/dazzling-bardeen/src/components/lms/LmsHeader.tsx) with the Atelier serif colophon, active desk status badge with terracotta bookmark rule, and instant portal shortcuts to `/admin` and `/dashboard`.

---

## 2. Verification Results

| Suite | Total Tests | Passed | Failed | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **E2E Opaque Runner** (`node tests/e2e-runner.js`) | 469 | 469 | 0 | PASSED |
| **Unit & Integration** (`npm test`) | 436 | 436 | 0 | PASSED |
| **TypeScript Type Checking** (`npx tsc --noEmit`) | Full Project | Clean | 0 | PASSED |
| **Next.js Production Build** (`npm run build`) | 10 Pages | 10 | 0 | PASSED |
| **Firebase Hosting Deployment** | 64 Files | 64 | 0 | DEPLOYED |

---

## 3. Production Deployment Details
- **Hosting URL**: `https://studysync-al-2026.web.app`
- **Cache Invalidation**: `Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate, max-age=0`
